save.idle: Moves save as you make them

lanes.title: Lanes
lanes.none: This site has no line or workshop yet.

lane.capacity: Next 4 weeks: {booked} of {available} min booked ({pct}%). The column counts every card in it.
lane.workshopCapacity: A workshop: its load in standard minutes is not planned here.

card.gone: This card is no longer on the board
card.goneBody: It was moved or the work order closed meanwhile: the board shows it as it is now.
card.title: {order} · {lane}
card.moveTitle: Move all or part of it
card.howManyHint: From 1 to {pieces}; the rest stays here.
card.rule: The work order's own line makes the garments no part names; a part goes to another line or a workshop, one part per lane.

held.readOnly: Read-only: only planners allocate work orders. You can look at the board and open the work orders.
held.readOnlyBody: Allocating needs the permission to change the working plan at this site.
held.offline: Offline — moves wait to be sent until the connection is back.
held.offlineBody: The board is read-only while the live channel is down; it reads everything again when it comes back.

board.title: Allocation board
board.hint: Drag a work order onto a line or a workshop; open a card to move part of its garments. Nothing reaches the floor until the plan is published.
board.label: Lines & subcontractors · {site}

error.title: Couldn't load the allocation board
error.forbidden: You may not see the allocation of this site.
error.offline: The server did not answer. Nothing is drawn, so an empty board is never shown by mistake.
error.failed: The allocation could not be read. Nothing is drawn, so an empty board is never shown by mistake.
error.noSite: This company has no site to plan yet.

refusal.STALE: The card is not in that column any more: the board was read again.
refusal.TOO_MANY: The card does not hold that many garments.
refusal.UNALLOCATED_PART: Part of an order cannot wait unallocated while the rest is on a line: move it to another lane.
refusal.CHANGED: The work order changed since it was read: the board was read again.
refusal.LOCKED: The work order is finished: its allocation stays as it was.
refusal.NOT_OPEN: The work order is not open any more: it is not allocated.
refusal.LANE_INACTIVE: That line or workshop is no longer active.
refusal.INVALID: This allocation cannot be saved as it is.
refusal.FORBIDDEN: You may not allocate work orders at this site.
refusal.NOT_FOUND: The work order is no longer on the board: the board was read again.
refusal.OFFLINE: No connection to the server: nothing was saved.
refusal.FAILED: The server did not save it. Try again.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.drop: Drop it there (or open the focused card)
keys.cancel: Cancel the move, close a dialog
